Check our new collection.'] %% Product Campaign STAT_PROD -->|If they didn't add to cart| CAM_PROD{Product View Campaign} CAM_PROD -->|Stage 1: 2 hrs delay| PROD_MSG1[💬 WhatsApp: 'Like the Blue Kurti?'] PROD_MSG1 -->|Stage 2: 24 hrs delay| PROD_MSG2[💬 WhatsApp: 'People also bought this'] %% Cart Campaign STAT_CART -->|If no checkout| CAM_CART{Cart Recovery Campaign} CAM_CART -->|Stage 1: 1 hr delay| CART_MSG1[💬 WhatsApp: 'Cart Waiting + Image + 10% Off'] CART_MSG1 -->|Stage 2: 24h delay| CART_MSG2[💬 WhatsApp: 'Last Chance!'] %% Hot User Promotion CART_MSG2 -.->|Reaches max 4 followups| ST_HOT([Status Upgraded to: HOT USER 🔥]) PROD_MSG2 -.->|Reaches max 4 followups| ST_HOT end %% ── 4. The Checkout Pivot (Conversion) ── subgraph Conversion ["The Checkout Pivot"] MSG_HOME -.->|User clicks & buys| CHECKOUT(Checkout Completed 💸) PROD_MSG1 -.->|User clicks & buys| CHECKOUT CART_MSG1 -.->|User clicks & buys| CHECKOUT NEW_USER -->|Buys instantly| CHECKOUT CHECKOUT ===>|Instantly triggers Tracker API| STAT_GUARD((STATUS GUARD ACTIVATED)) STAT_GUARD -->|1. Immediately deletes/stops any pending Cart/Product reminders| CANCEL_SPAM[🚫 Auto-Cancel all annoying reminders] STAT_GUARD -->|2. Upgrades user profile| STAT_PURCH[Status: Purchased] end %% ── 5. The Post-Purchase Cycle ── subgraph PostPurchase ["The Rebirth (Post-Purchase Flow)"] STAT_PURCH -->|Now eligible only for this| CAM_POST{Post-Purchase Campaign} CAM_POST -->|Immediate| THANK_MSG[💬 WhatsApp: 'Thank you for your order! Here is your receipt.'] THANK_MSG -->|3 days later (Upsell)| UPSELL_MSG[💬 WhatsApp: 'Since you bought Blue Kurti, you might like these matching earrings.'] UPSELL_MSG -->|30 days later| REORDER_MSG[💬 WhatsApp: 'Get 20% off your next purchase!'] REORDER_MSG -.->|User clicks and buys again| CHECKOUT end %% ── 6.
